anomalies.what: RT3-C1 reports that weighting by psi(d) instead of d 'changes it by < 0.001' bits. The frozen contract records that as 'a claim this run checks rather than assumes'. MEASURED HERE: the change is up to 0.031346 bits at the two anchor pairs, i.e. larger than 0.001.
anomalies.psi_definition_used: psi(d) = Dedekind psi = d * prod_{p|d}(1+1/p) = prod p^(e-1)(p+1), the number of cyclic subgroups of order d, accumulated in exact integer arithmetic
anomalies.direction: psi-weighting up-weights integers with many small prime factors, so it moves mass toward smaller P(d) and makes Delta LARGER, i.e. the correction MORE attack-favourable, not less
